comments.value: Por favor vrchat. Precisamos de um server BR

Assino embaixo! Eu e toda a família Moon's Club! 💝

🤔 Talvez seja importante você editar e acrescentar uma tradução em inglês, para que a equipe do VRChat consiga ler.
@{64e74bd037f14c42021da64d|full_name}o original é em ingles, mas nos vemos em portugues
Precisamos de uns servidores BR! Mesmo que seja uma feature experimental ou em uma BETA proxima

Concordo, precisamos nois brasileiros de uma correção sobre valores e servidores. A cada Dia mais e mais pessoas novas aq do Brasil Aparecem pra jogar Vrchat e enfrentam esses pobremas logo de cara prejudicando a imersão.
They should consider having a South America server somewhere. We live in pain over 150+ ping. Karaoke maps are very desynced and fast paced games don't work well. Come on, we exist.
Realmente é muito caro pra gente, nossa moeda não é muito valorizada

I'd honestly love to support the game with VRC+ plus as the post says the prices are *really* expensive considering our currency. That alone would help us a lot, but a server would make so so many people over her much more comfortable playing the game as well

details:
We need a South America localized server!! 
Playing VRC with 160ms+, it's horrible! You cant make choreography, create content (people look like dumb, or cut you while talking). And this would be a HUGE improvement for the South America at all.
And if you can locate the prices since vrchat plus price is NOT located to our currency, which is R$50 (10$). It would be interesting if the price was R$25 (5$), same as discord prices like $9.99 to $4.99 in BRL would be R$51 to R$25 , this did a lot of people pay for it.
So We REALLY need this changes!
